subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers require redacted live current-main Slack Socket Mode reaction diagnostics before authorizing a fix PR for this report?
rationale: Source inspection proves handler-level support but not the live failing boundary, so an automated code fix would be guessing between Slack/Bolt delivery, account filtering, and authorization.

options.title: Require live diagnostics first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for redacted raw reaction envelopes or absence-of-envelope proof plus gateway trace/status output before code changes.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer live repro
options.body: Have a maintainer run a controlled multi-account Slack Socket Mode repro and then open a focused fix once the first failing boundary is known.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode triage
options.body: Move this under the broader Slack Socket Mode report only if that report receives reaction-specific logs proving the same root cause.

recommendation.title: Require live diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for redacted raw reaction envelopes or absence-of-envelope proof plus gateway trace/status output before code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior binding-aware system-event routing work makes Vincent Koc the best current routing owner for deciding whether the next step is proof or a follow-up fix.
